Done! Here's what changed in [view-grocery/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/deepak/OneDrive/Desktop/Major%20project%20Nextjs/grocerygoFolder/grocerygo/src/app/admin/view-grocery/page.tsx):

**Layout changes:**
- **Grid → List**: Switched from a 3-column grid of cards to a single-column list layout inside a white rounded container, matching your screenshot
- **Each row**: Image on the left → Name, category, price in the middle → Edit & Delete buttons on the right
- **Search bar**: Added a centered search bar that filters by name or category
- **Top bar**: "← Back" on the left, "🧊 Manage Groceries" on the right

**New features added:**
- **Search/filter**: Real-time filtering by grocery name or category
- **Edit modal**: Clicking "Edit" opens a modal where you can update name, category, price, unit, and image — all submitted via your existing `/api/admin/edit-grocery` PUT endpoint
- **Delete button**: Kept alongside the Edit button as a compact trash icon

The dev server should hot-reload automatically. Refresh `/admin/view-grocery` to see the new layout.
